name: Cooperative Intelligence of Language Model Agents
description: The task is to develop language model agents capable of effective cooperation in mixed-motive, text-mediated environments using the Concordia framework. Agents must demonstrate skills such as promise-keeping, negotiation, and compromise in diverse scenarios.
paper_id: The Concordia Contest: Advancing the Cooperative Intelligence of Language Model Agents

cr:input.name: Concordia Scenarios Dataset
cr:input.description: A set of mixed-motive social dilemma scenarios provided by the Concordia framework. These scenarios include natural language descriptions of the environment and co-player behaviors, which agents use as input. Example: 'Dorothy goes grocery shopping for dinner and overhears Charlie talking about Alice.'

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: The expected output is natural language descriptions of the agents' actions and intentions in response to the scenarios. Example: 'Charlie sets up a stand to talk to people about Alice's bad deeds.'

field.name: action_description
field.description: A natural language description of the agent's intended action. Example: 'Dorothy goes grocery shopping for dinner.'

field.name: interaction_description
field.description: A natural language description of the interaction outcome as determined by the Game Master. Example: 'Charlie is kicked out of the grocery store for disturbing other customers.'
